documents.title: 49ers Wednesday Injury Report
documents.text: Did not participate: LB Fred Warner (ankle). Limited: WR Brandon Aiyuk (hamstring).

documents.title: 49ers sign cornerback to practice squad
documents.text: The 49ers signed a cornerback to the practice squad on Wednesday.

documents.title: Kyle Shanahan Wednesday press conference
documents.text:
Q: What stood out on the film?

Shanahan: We have to be better on third down. That's on all of us,
starting with me.
